name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
steps: Loop a resistance band securely over a pull-up bar, take a wider-than-shoulder overhand grip, and place one knee or foot safely inside the hanging loop.
Start from a controlled straight-arm hang with your shoulder blades pulled slightly down and core braced.
Pull your elbows down and back to raise your chest until your chin clears the bar.
Lower smoothly back to full arm extension, and hold the band securely before stepping out when finished.
tips: Keep the band centered under your knee or arch so it cannot slip off suddenly.
Control the bottom of each repetition instead of letting the stretched band bounce you upward.
